title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Data Factory module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-datafactory'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_role_assignment.description: Whether to create the Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User role assignment. Set to false if the role assignment already exists.

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string expiration_date = string identity_id = string identity_principal_id = string })
customer_managed_key.description: (Required) An customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." identity_principal_id = "(Required) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." })

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

github_configuration.type: object({ account_name = string branch_name = string git_url = string repository_name = string root_folder = string publishing_enabled = optional(bool, false) })
github_configuration.description: (Optional) An Object of GitHub Configuration: account_name = "(Required) Specifies the GitHub account name." branch_name = "(Required) Specifies the branch of the repository to get code from." git_url = "(Required) Specifies the GitHub Enterprise host name. For example: https://github.mydomain.com. Use https://github.com for open source repositories." repository_name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the git repository." root_folder = "(Required) Specifies the root folder within the repository. Set to / for the top level." publishing_enabled = "(Optional) Is automated publishing enabled?"

global_parameter.type: list(object({ name = string type = string value = string }))
global_parameter.description: (Optional) A List of Global Parameters: name = "(Required) Specifies the global parameter name." type = "(Required) Specifies the global parameter type. Possible Values are `Array`, `Bool`, `Float`, `Int`, `Object` or `String`." value = "(Required) Specifies the global parameter value."

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Data Factory. Possible values are `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned`, `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Data Factory. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

managed_virtual_network_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether to enable Managed Virtual Network or not.

purview_id.description: (Optional) Specifies the ID of the purview account resource associated with the Data Factory.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

resource_id.description: (Required) The resource identifier of the integration runtime to be shared.

Defaults to 1." credential_name = "(Optional) The name of a Data Factory Credential that the SSIS integration will use to access data sources.If credential_name is omitted, the integration runtime will use the Data Factory assigned identity." max_parallel_executions_per_node = "(Optional) Defines the maximum parallel executions per node. Defaults to 1. Max is 1." edition = "(Optional) The Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime edition. Valid values are Standard and Enterprise. Mutually exclusive with pricing_tier." dual_standby_pair_name = "(Optional) The dual standby Azure-SSIS Integration Runtime pair with SSISDB failover." copy_compute_scale = "(Optional) A copy_compute_scale block for Data Factory Integration Runtime: data_integration_unit = "(Optional) Specifies the data integration unit number setting reserved for copy activity execution. agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Datafactory' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
